note: caiso-148 nuclear-availability recipe + THE FIRM MUST-FLOW FLOOR CLIPPED AT CAISO'S OWN MEASURED PRICE-INSENSITIVE INTERTIE CEILING (caiso-151, single-flag delta caiso_firm_import_selfsched_clip=true, promoted 2026-07-31 on rule 1 [R-STRUCT] + rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] grounds, KNOWINGLY E1-ADVERSE). THE DEFECT IT FIXES: the caiso-77 floor (armed in every CAISO keeper since) pins both firm tranches' min_gen at their FULL shaped capability, and its rule-17 window declaration rests on 'the measured (month x hod) median self-schedule' — but the series it actually uses (measured_firm_import_shape) is EIA-930 realised NET CORRIDOR INTERCHANGE, i.e. a broadly flat price-insensitive core PLUS a large price-ELASTIC economic layer, and the floor attributes that entire diurnal swing to the price-insensitive core. Measured at caiso-150 against CAISO's own as-submitted DAM bids — a source independent of BOTH inputs the floor consumes — the unclipped floor forces more price-insensitive import than CAISO's ENTIRE measured price-insensitive intertie position (both directions unsigned PLUS every import bid at <= $0/MWh, the floor's own definition of price-taking conduct per CPUC D.20-06-028) in 23.9/47.2/48.9 % of hours, and the defect GROWS with the DMM RA level. THE MECHANISM: min_gen[t] = min(pmax x availability[t], ceiling[t]), the system ceiling allocated across firm tranches pro rata by their own shaped capability so NO allocation parameter is introduced. It clips the FLOOR and never the CAPABILITY — above the measured ceiling the import is still available, merely price-ELASTIC, so it is offered to the LP as economic capability instead of forced; clipping availability would delete real import capability. ZERO new free parameters (rule 24): a pointwise min of two measured series, structurally the accepted caiso-138 envelope-clip pattern, COMPOSING with it as a second min on its OWN flag (rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]) and RECONCILING the caiso-73 shape rather than stacking on it. THE SERIES is a rule-23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE] frozen derive over CAISO OASIS PUB_BID_DAM (357 seasonally- and year-balanced trade days, 1,574,341 resource-hours, 1,531 masked seqs) whose FOUR honesty gates were declared EX ANTE and ALL PASS: G1 year-stability CV 0.042 (gate <=0.20), G2 LOYO level 4.6/8.4/4.6 % (<=25 %), G3 LOYO SHAPE 19.3/12.3/18.6 % median over ALL 288 (month x hod) buckets (<=25 %), G4 coverage 288/288 buckets sampled in all three years. OASIS rows are RUN-LENGTH ENCODED and are expanded to hour slots before any hourly statistic; clock is exact UTC -> US/Pacific. The corpus is an INDEPENDENT re-fetch (caiso-150's was gitignored) and reproduces it on every checkable dimension: unclassifiable self-schedule share 94.54 % (caiso-150: 94.91 %), diurnal swing 1.52x (1.49x), overnight ceiling 3,388-3,542 MW (3,381-3,443). Per-year ceiling levels are FLAT at 3,886/4,241/3,886 MW while the DMM RA level the floor is sized from steps 2,323 -> 3,371 MW. disposition_note: DETERMINATION CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, carried over from the caiso-148 keeper UNCHANGED IN SUBSTANCE. The two ledgered measured-input caveats remain the OWNER's act of 2026-07-30 (caiso-145) — C3c-2023/24 on caiso-131 §9 disposition A4 with the caiso-144 evidence, and C3a-2025 on the caiso-141 A2 data wall — re-stated against this bundle with magnitudes re-measured on its own bytes, NOT a fresh grant by caiso-151 and NOT a new ledger slot (still 2 of 3 non-protective, 0 of 1 protective, 0 FAILs). C3c is BIT-IDENTICAL to the control (model 0 h > $200 in every year, identical maxima $188/$149/$74). THIS KEEPER WAS PROMOTED KNOWING IT MAKES THE PRICE FIT SLIGHTLY WORSE, and that is recorded here rather than buried. The clip is E1-ADVERSE BY CONSTRUCTION and was pre-registered as such BEFORE either arm solved: removing forced cheap overnight import raises overnight lambda (+$0.043/+$0.376/+$0.224 per MWh in h22-h05), and CAISO's model lambda already sits ABOVE the RT actual, so the C3a miss GROWS: +3.01 -> +3.06 % (2023), +8.05 -> +8.68 % (2024), +11.23 -> +11.72 % (2025). All three movements are BELOW the 1.0 pp materiality trigger PREREG-caiso151 §6 fixed in advance (+0.045/+0.626/+0.494 pp), so none is built upon — but the 2025 movement is an order of magnitude larger than the 0.0 pp caiso-148 recorded and is called out explicitly. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] governs the promotion: a structurally-correct mechanism stays in even when the fit worsens, and the response to a worse fit is to name the root cause, never to revert. Equally, rule 1 forbids adopting a mechanism BECAUSE a residual moved — this one is adopted because the floor it clips forces more price-insensitive import than CAISO's own bid record can support in roughly half of all hours. It does NOT reopen the C3a-2025 caveat: reopening requires new evidence against a named caiso-140/141/142/143/144 DO-NOT-REDO cell, or the owner-funded non-public hourly pumped-storage intake. RULE 22 leave-one-year-out: the mechanism introduces NO fitted parameter, so there is nothing to overfit; the LOYO requirement is discharged at the derive stage by gates G2 (level) and G3 (shape), both leave-one-year-out within 2023-2025 and both PASS in every held-out year. The in-solve effect is same-signed and monotone across all three years (forcing removed 4.9/16.7/19.6 %, overnight lambda +0.043/+0.376/+0.224), so no single year drives it. CAISO still holds NO rule-22 calibration-complete marker, so every out-of-training year (2022, 2019, <=2021, H1-2026) stays fully quarantined; this session solved 2023/2024/2025 only and wrote no marker. CORRECTION TO A caiso-150 CLAIM, and to this session's own first statement of it: caiso-150 §A reported that MECH_FIRM_IMPORT is invisible to the D-4 off-window check BECAUSE it carries no D4_WINDOWS entry. Adding that entry (done here) is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT — the firm_import row STILL does not appear in either arm's legitimacy_diagnostics.json. Measured cause: the diagnostics harness scores a PLANT-aggregated matrix built from CAMPD plant ids, and the intertie tranches carry plant_code 0 with an empty plant_group, so they are dropped from the all_pids matrix that D-1/D-2/D-4 all score. Run D-4 directly on the unaggregated LP rows and the row appears immediately (firm_import, 15.4689 TWh floored, 2024, window h0-23, off-window share 0.000, pass). So the floor's gate-invisibility has TWO causes, and the binding one is the plant-set restriction, not the missing window. That is an ISO-GENERIC diagnostics-harness defect — it equally hides MISO's Manitoba and NYISO's HQ firm must-flow blocks — and is FILED, NOT ABSORBED: it belongs to the diagnostics lane, not a CAISO lever session. The D4_WINDOWS entry is kept because it is a correct rule-12/17 declaration and is required for the row ever to appear. KNOWN LIMITATION (caiso-150 §B, unchanged and not engineered around): the import/export direction of intertie self-schedules is NOT identifiable — 94.54 % of self-scheduled MW sits on resources that never submit an economic curve, and the masked feed carries no direction field. The ceiling is therefore ONE-SIDED by construction, which is exactly why the mechanism is sound: it uses only ceiling >= true import position, so it can only ever REMOVE forcing the measured record cannot support, never add any. The midday ratio 0.26-0.34 must NOT be read as under-forcing — midday is where CAISO export self-schedules peak, so the unsigned ceiling is most generous there.
